article.story: VERMILLION, S.D. -- — Matthew Willenborg had 22 points in Cal State Fullerton’s 87-85 victory against South Dakota on Saturday. Willenborg also contributed eight rebounds and three blocks for the Titans (1-1). Joshua Ward added 19 points to go with 10 rebounds and eight assists. Vince Buzelis led the Coyotes (1-2) in scoring, finishing with 26 points and 10 rebounds. Josiah Dotzler added 13 points and two steals for South Dakota. Jahni Summers had 10 points. Up next CSU Fullerton faces Lincoln (CA) at home on Thursday, and South Dakota hosts Houston Christian on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
